notes.title: 【1.0 Release】Theseus Protocol is now in version 1.0.
notes.notes:
After a period of polishing and optimization,  Theseus Accord officially launched its official version on August 22nd. We would like to thank all the players who have been with us since EA. 

The 1.0 version can now be experienced in full:
[olist]
3 characters with different fighting styles.
9 weapons with different characteristics and over 80 weapon chips.
4 major levels, each with 40 randomly generated mini-levels and 22 random events to learn about the story as you progress through the levels.
66 enemies with different forms and skills
collectable total of 287 cards, 137 pieces of equipment, 26 items.
3 game modes:
    Normal: simple monster behavior.
    Difficult: with some challenge.
    Deep Dive: customizable game content via components, includes 7 built-in difficulties (Normal, Hard, 
    Deep Dive-Deep Sea LV1-3, Supercomputer, Superbody). Also you can customize your level with 82 
    deep Dive components!
[/olist]

This new update is as follows:
. Added a new boss recovery mechanic: Normal Mode restores 100% of HP, Hard Mode restores 50%, Deep Dive Mode does not take effect.
. Added Charlotte's exclusive component in Deep Dive Mode: Weapon Master, which allows you to carry all unlocked weapons in battle.
. Added Japanese translation.

notes.title: [Test version 0.8.0509]Major Update: New mode, New mechanism, New experience!
notes.notes:
After a period of beta testing, we have received a lot of feedback and suggestions from players. We would like to sincerely thank our players for their continued support! We have decided to release the new version to the official version, and we hope that this version of Theseus Protocol can bring a better experience to you!

NOTE:

This update will clear players' battle archives (game settings, user archives remain). We expect to update after 8:00 AM PST  on the 8th, players should prepare in advance (we recommend playing through or abandoning the file!)

The overall update content is as follows:


-Difficulty
·New Normal difficulty: Original Easy difficulty has now been changed to Normal difficulty, and the behavior logic of some enemies has been simplified. The intention description is now more accurate and detailed.
·New Hard difficulty: Compared to Normal difficulty, new enemies have been added: Evolution Cult Disciple (male, elite), Community Aerial Rescue Model, and SWAT Robot (Hacked). Enemy health and armor will be increased by 10%, and all enemy behavior patterns or damage values have been adjusted, as well as some scene effects.

-Cards
·162 cards were remade, and 12 new cards were added.
·Added card details viewing function, users can click on a card in the compendium or deck to view more detailed explanation.
·Improvements made to the rhythm of using all cards for a smoother experience.

-Equipment
·All equipment has been redesigned.
·Added rarity labels to equipment drops and adjust the visual display of equipment accordingly.

-Weapon
·Adjustments made to basic weapon abilities and values.
·Removed the weapon chip unlocking and upgrading related functions.
·Weapon unlocking will only be associated with character level. Players will unlock all character weapons when they reach level 4.
·Removed basic small-size and medium-size chips.
·Modifications were made to some of the large chip functions, and several new functionalities were added to the chip.
·The weapon slot unlocking rule was modified: it will be unlocked according to character level.
·Added an "Imbuement" function to weapons. After recharging or using certain cards, players can imbue their weapons, which will gain additional effects or increased ability.
·Added weapon enhancement feature inside the game, which can be selected at resting points.
·Some weapon names were changed:  
Spark Plug -> Burning Star 
Flame Spirit -> Fire God
Fire Protection Fingerstall -> Glowing Wing 
Firelight Chaser -> Flame Sparrow.

-Character
·Nena's Super High-Spirit: When Nena enters Super High-Spirit, gain 8 Pleasure. At the end of the turn, gain 15 Shield and 30 mood value. 
·Nena has a new summon, Trumpy, which has its own unique gameplay mechanics that can be explored during the game.

-New Function
·Added game records and details function.
·Added story and art-works for loading pages before a BOSS fight.
·Armor repair function and weapon enhancement function were added at resting points.

-Optimization:
·DATA tokens for outside game development have been removed due to limitations with outside development. This feature was temporarily disabled, but the original DATA tokens in the archive will be preserved in case relevant feature design can be used in the future.
·Added dialogue for some enemies.
·Adjustments were made to all descriptions in the game to be more accurate and standardized.
 ·Unified rules were set for all in-game values, where all shield gains can now enjoy bonuses. Damage was divided into constant damage, normal damage, and piercing damage, with relevant explanations available in-game tutorial.
·Intentions were modified to more clearly distinguish between melee, AOE, constant damage, normal damage, and piercing damage.
·Store interface display optimization.
· Adjustments made to victory and defeat result panels, which will now display results in terms of points. Character experience will be settled proportionally.
·Adjustments made to some enemy behaviors.
·Some buff values or functionalities were adjusted.
·Settlement timing of card, weapon, and other function was modified to be more intuitive.

notes.title: [Test version 0.6.0217] 2.17 Regular update announcement
notes.notes:
The EA version of "The Theseus Protocol" has been released for one month~ 
Today we also have updates!
During this month, you have given us a lot of feedback and suggestions. We have read them all carefully, and have been doing game optimization and adjustment, thank you for your patience and support!
We will speed up the making new contents!

Attention
This update will clear players' battle archives (game settings, user archives retained), we expect to update in the afternoon or evening of the 17th. At the same time, we advise you players to prepare in advance (suggest to play through or abandon the file!)

Version Update Overview.

 New feature: The acceleration function is now available. You can now use the speed function to accelerate the whole game.
 Card adjustments: This time we made functional adjustments on existing cards (we remade about 30 basic cards that were not very interesting) and added 15 new cards (weapon related cards)
 Adjusted the logic of the level and removed the bonus preview function.
 Weakened the attack and life values of some enemies (mainly in the third map)
 Now as the Boss of the map, Blue Flame and Rudraksha will be more aggressive and self-protective.
 UI function optimization: the graphic recognition of equipment icons is improved, and the performance of some parts of the battle interface is optimized.
 Fix some known bugs.

Overall Update

 Improve the taunt mechanism and non-selectable performance.
 Optimize the performance of weapon continuous shooting.
 Adjust the layout of props and equipment in the battle interface.
 Optimize weapon selection and chip interface.
 New reminder to clear the battle archive.
 Optimize the interface of card selection and card library.
 Add the function of viewing cards during the battle and at the settlement of card selection.

Art and Visual Effects.
Update the logo degree of equipment icons.

In the coming March updates, we will focus on the following (not in order of priority).        

 New cards, equipment, props
 Fourth Map
 Normal difficulty
 Reward system optimization
 Rest point feature added and everyone's favorite treasure spot!
 Achievement System
 Continuous visual updates


The next patch update of "Theseus Protocol" will be more frequent. In order to give you a better game experience, we will open the BETA test of the updated version of the game. Participation in the test for feedback will affect our design of the cards, weapons, maps, and other content. Anyone interested is welcome to contact us at Discord!

Thanks again for your support and encouragement!
See you in the next update!

notes.title: [Test version 0.6.0202] 2.2 Regular update announcement
notes.notes:
Version update overview.


 New feature: The Compendium is accessible, now you can view all cards and equipment from the current version in the main menu.
 Weapon chip system reworked: We have adjusted the weapon chips. The load will now increase based on player level. With more reasonable enhancement limits, it will be a new challenge to match weapon chips.
 Balance Adjustment: This time we focus on the balance adjustment of existing cards and equipment.
 Adjusted Nena's mood system: 5→3 levels of valiance gained under Lose-Control, gain a random symbiotic card every turn under High-Spirited.
 Fix the problem that the game cloud archive did not take effect properly and the archive was lost in some cases.


Attention

This update will clear players' battle archives (game settings and user archives are retained), weapon chips will be cleared of reinforcement level and loading when the game is started for the first time after the update, and compensate for the cost of enough reinforcement to the original state.

Overall Update


 players can now view the weapon screen in combat.
 updated the logic for reward drops.
 Card Choice screen optimized to allow vertical dragging or scroll wheel page turning when there are more cards.
 Automatic target locking when players use cards, weapons, or props, except for special operations in specified locations, will not be released on empty space when the target is displaced.
 All equipment, cards and props filled with weapon energy can no longer break the cap to overload the weapon.
 Cards used directly by Choice no longer enter the pile.
 Evasion works on piercing damage.
 Cards that are currently played will not be counted when the discard pile is retrieved or counted.
 To prevent possible system crashes, the game cannot run in the background.
 In-game video content optimization, Win7 and other systems can also play the animation normally.
 Game settings are increased for clearer picture quality.

Dear players.

We have fixed most of the black screen, flashing, game crashes and other bugs!

 Fixed the black screen situation where some players cannot enter the main interface when opening the game.

 Fixed the problem of incorrectly skipping rewards for props.
 Fixed the function that cards can do damage to themselves in some cases.
 Fixed the problem that the special effects on the grid follow the movement of the character.
 Fixed the bug that weapons are rounded down when they are charged by percentage.
 Fixed the problem that the game process appears when the cards kill both sides at the same time. Now priority settlement of monster damage.
 Fixed the problem that weapon chip - Thermal Detector did not reduce the cooldown reduction correctly.
 Fixed the issue that weapon chip - Mobile Shot tier is incorrectly configured.
 Fixed the problem that the equipment added in some battles still exists after SL.
 Fixed the problem that the word of the card disappears in some cases.
 Fix the unlocked small chip status display problem.
 Fixed the problem of abnormal face of some cards.
 Fixed the problem that the exposure of some equipment screen is too high.
 Fixed the problem that the discount of black gold card is not indicated in the store.


Other optimizations

 Default FPS has been reduced from 120 to 60.
 Improved the issue where detailed armor values could not be viewed when shields were present.
 Updated the visual representation of cards that cannot be recharged.
 Updated the description of the tutorial.
 Optimized the font size and overall screen size of the event screen.
 Modified some cards with incorrect description effects, including terminology explanation.
 Optimized the frequency of Boss Blue Flame transformation and enhanced the strength of one form.
 Fixed the abnormal behavior of Crow Fist Thug.
 Fixed the abnormal SWAT commander interference card stuffing problem.
 Fixed the abnormal behavior of the attack of the Gorilla Monster and changed the machine gun strafing from fixed attack to random attack.
 Optimized some monster movements and special effects.
 Added special effect performance to independent counterattack.
 Added sound effects when moving, enemies die, and shields are generated.
 Changed the increment of store deletion cards from 5 points to 25 points.
 Skip bonus for equipment and cards changed from 15 points to 30 points.
 Increased the unlock cost of medium and large chips.


The following card balances were made.

 [Meteor Storm]
     Deal 2 damage to all enemies 5 times, Exhaust.
 [Driver Shield]
     Action cost +1
     Gain {1} shield, draw 1 card, every 10 Shield you have, draw additional 1 card.
 [Magnetic Storm]
     Deal damage to a target equal to 3 times its Periodic Shocks. 
 [Ambush]
     Remove all Valiance on you. Deal 4 damage for each Valiance is removed.
 [Suppressive Fire]
     Deal {1} damage to a target 4 times. 
 [Metal Beast Fu Xi]
     Action cost +1.
 [Metal Beast Qiu Niu]
     Action cost +1.
 [Metal Beast Ba Xia]
     Action cost -1.
 [Metal Beast Ya Zi]
     Action cost -1. Base damage becomes 16.
 [Metal Beast Chao Feng]
     This card will be exhausted when used.


In the EA phase we will continue to adjust and fix the game ~ hope to bring you guys a better game experience!

Welcome to join our Discord: https://discord.gg/x9GV2yaFSc. Please contact the administrator to give the feedback.

Again, thank you for the support of Theseus Protocol!

notes.title: EA version release date confirmed
notes.notes:
The EA release date for "The Theseus Protocol" has been set for January 17, 2023, and the game does not include in-app purchase items.

At that time, you will be able to experience the following content:

2 controllable characters, Charlotte, and Nena.
Charlotte can unlock up to 4 weapons and Nena can unlock up to 2 weapons.

Weapon system [Hippocampus Reflow] containing 140 weapon enhancement modules, with different weapon schools that can bring more gains to the battle.

244 cards, divided into three categories: offensive, defensive, and tactical cards. Different characters will have their own exclusive cards.

107 pieces of equipment, which can be matched with the right equipment according to your need.

26 randomly dropped props, only 3 prop slots can be equipped props. Please use them flexibly in battle, if the props are not consumed, you can only replace or discard the prop rewards when you get new props again.

3 complete map levels, 6 BOSS, 8 elite enemies, 40 normal enemies randomly appear in any level. Enemies attack in different ways, you need to adjust your strategy at any time.

We will be releasing more free updates in subsequent versions, including maps, weapons, characters, gameplay, and other content, so stay tuned!
